subject: District Inclusion and Accommodation Statement
overview: The Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee met to review inclusion and accommodation language for district communications and policies. The subcommittee voted to recommend amending the district's non-discrimination policy to add an accommodation statement.

items.title: Discussion on District Inclusion and Accommodation Statements
items.summary: Subcommittee members and district staff discussed options for inclusion and accommodation statements, focusing on accessibility for field trips, school-sponsored events, and PTO activities.

items.title: Recommendation to Amend Non-Discrimination Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to recommend that the full School Committee amend policy AC to add the proposed inclusion and accommodation language.
